title: Thanksgiving weather forecast: Coastal storm could bring rain to Tri-State
text:
Thanksgiving weather forecast: Coastal storm could bring rain to Tri-State - ABC7 New York 
 24/7 Live New York City New Jersey Long Island Northern Suburbs Connecticut WEATHER 
 Storm threat builds for Thanksgiving week across the Tri-State 
 Stream New York's #1 news - AccuWeather - original content 24/7 Friday, November 20, 2026 9:34PM Share Follow abc7NY on Google NEW YORK (WABC) -- A pleasant stretch has brought warm November temperatures but we are looking ahead to changes coming this weekend and ahead of Thanksgiving.
 The same area of high pressure that has been responsible for the pleasant weather will gradually shift east, opening the door for a developing system along the Southeast coast to begin moving northward.
 For now, Saturday remains in good shape until cloud cover increases Saturday afternoon before rain arrives on Sunday.
 Light showers could begin moving into the area Sunday afternoon as the coastal system lifts northward.
 The heaviest rain will kick in Sunday evening with a general 1-2 inches of rain with higher totals possible on Long Island.
 Depending on the storm track, there may be a sharp cutoff in our western suburbs where rainfall totals could be significantly less.
 Winds could gust over 30 mph at the coast where there could also be some minor coastal flooding.
 The system should move quickly east of Long Island by Monday, allowing travel conditions to improve and setting up a drier stretch of weather for the start of next week.
 Attention then turns to the Thanksgiving holiday travel period, when another coastal storm could affect the region.
 Rain chances are increasing for the Thanksgiving Day Parade.
 And yet another storm could move up the coast next weekend.
